description: UFO mini-story part 2/4: Lucia helps the woman from the beam, the sleep spam does nothing, Jason is healed and the dream begins. Beats in stream order: frame-0 teaser (h5 25:10, the black portal in the white dream void, 1.2 s); the woman from the beam (h4 28:46-29:32): Lucia runs through the dark forest, presses HELP on the dazed woman, 'kau tak apa-apa? kau ingat apa-apa?', she asks Lucia to bring her car ('ya, oke, tunggu disini'); Windah tries to reach the UFO (29:55 'bisa gue deketin UFO-nya pas?'); he finds a sleep-skip lead (31:30 'ada lanjutan questnya: spam tidur?', 31:35 'coba gue spam tidur ya'); label SPAM TIDUR, GAK ADA MIMPI over the gym (38:45, after eight sleeps nothing happened: 'kita kombo sama aktivitas'); h5 24:05 'gue ajak tidur Jason, apakah teori mimpi itu nyata? teori UFO?' and 24:16 'karena kita akan tidur dalam keadaan Jason udah sembuh'; the dream begins: white void, 'dunia futuristik... hah? lubang' (25:01) and the portal opens (25:05). Word timings from short-window faster-whisper medium with VAD (in-game voices lines 'oh Tuhan', 'ya oke' etc. are captioned as heard, in Indonesian). CUT: h4 28:57.5-29:04 (Lucia's 'Oh... the fuck?', whisper 'Sial!' at 29:02.3-29:03), the in-game subtitle 'Lucia: What... the fuck?' at 28:41-28:45 (clip starts 28:45.7), h4 29:14-29:22 (woman close-ups and Lucia's cleavage at ~29:20), the sleep scenes with Lucia in a bra top and shirtless Jason (h4 31:50-37:50, 41:00-41:50, h5 24:20-24:45), the bench-press shots at 38:10-38:40, the dream's 'Where the hell is this?' subtitle (h5 24:48-24:55). Woman scene: only the dark wide shots of her. No guns, gore, drugs in these frames. Main 40.65 s + 4.0 s outro. Short format (user, 19 Nov: clips 45-60 s lost viewers at ~10 s, so aim for 20-30 s, payoff first).
